scenarios.name: should resolve local options
scenarios.given: a stable inline or locally initialized object
scenarios.then: the matching static initializer property is returned

scenarios.name: should honor spread and override order
scenarios.given: known spreads, duplicate keys, or later unknown spreads
scenarios.when: properties are inspected from right to left
scenarios.then: the final effective value is returned or uncertainty blocks acceptance

scenarios.name: should reject unsafe property resolution
scenarios.given: computed unknown keys, accessors, cycles, or directly mutated local objects
scenarios.then: null is returned rather than trusting an unreliable initializer

scenarios.name: should allow unrelated properties
scenarios.given: known literal properties and spreads lacking the requested key

scenarios.name: should retain mutation checks through TypeScript wrappers
scenarios.given: an options identifier wrapped in assertions whose property was directly reassigned
scenarios.then: the initializer is rejected as unreliable even when the identifier is wrapped
